items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh yeah. Yeah I played with Bib many times.

ctx.x: Never did. Never work at the Palace Theater. I ain't working at no theaters. I ain't working at no theaters. I ain't working at no theaters. What about on One-Eyed Babe? Did you ever play with him?
Oh yeah. Yeah I played with Bib many times. Did some nice job for Bib. Bib used to get some nice job for the way people uptown that way.
He's way up there on that, up at the Governor's fleets and so that people, all the people know they used to give them a lot of nice work. They got a nice job for Bib.
